name: prayer
description: The act of communicating with a sacred entity.
alternateDefinitions: 'Prayer' can also be used to mean 'hope'.
perceptions: My mind could use some calming or I could use some advice.
Communicating with God or a saint may help.
results: Prayers are not always answered. Depends on what is said.
examples: Formal prayer in a group setting.

guidance.description: Different religions have similar types of prayers: asking for help, asking to help others, declaring your dedicated faith, and others.

variations.name: prayer of petition
variations.description: The act of communicating with a sacred entity for help with something.
perceptions: I could use some help or guidance.
Communicating with God or a saint may help.
results: Prayers are not always answered. Depends on what is said.

guidance.description: Your religious community may have specific guidance for different types of prayer. Here are some examples.

variations.name: prayer of faith
variations.description: The act of communicating with a sacred entity to confirm your relationship.
perceptions: Communicating with God or a saint will help further the relationship.
results: Prayers are not always answered. Depends on what is said.

guidance.description: Your religious community may have specific guidance for different types of prayer. Here are some examples.

variations.name: prayer for others
variations.description: The act of communicating with a sacred entity to help another.
perceptions: Someone could use some help or guidance.
Communicating with God or a saint may help them.
results: Prayers are not always answered. Depends on what is said.

guidance.description: Your religious community may have specific guidance for different types of prayer. Here are some examples.

comparisons.description: Prayer and mediation are complementary ways of improving your mental state and therefore your world. Prayer is a personal relationship with your religion's sacred beings. Communication with the existential is a natural way for humans to grapple with the big questions. Meditation is more inward-focused, paying careful attention to your own subtle experiences. Both practices help billions of people.

commentaries.quote: To be a Christian without prayer is no more possible than to be alive without breathing.
It is better in prayer to have a heart without words than words without a heart.
A generous prayer is never presented in vain; the petition may be refused, but the petitioner is always, I believe, rewarded by some gracious visitation.
God speaks in the silence of the heart. Listening is the beginning of prayer.
Don't pray when it rains if you don't pray when the sun shines.
True prayer is neither a mere mental exercise nor a vocal performance. It is far deeper than that. It is a spiritual transaction with the creator of Heaven and Earth.
